title: Test Examination of Conscience
description: A simplified examination for testing purposes with just 3 sections and 2 questions each.

categories.title: Section One: Prayer Life
categories.description: A brief examination of your prayer habits.

items.text: Have I taken time for daily prayer?
items.clarification: This is a sample clarification to test that feature.

items.text: Have I been attentive during prayer or easily distracted?
Have I been kind and patient with others?
items.clarification: Remember that charity is expressed in our everyday interactions.

items.text: Have I helped someone in need when I had the opportunity?
Have I been willing to admit my mistakes?
items.clarification: Humility allows us to acknowledge our faults and grow from them.

items.text: Have I put others before myself when appropriate?
